snippet.title: Pokémon Epsilon Emerald Trailer
snippet.description:
Soar over Hoenn November 14th in my complete demake/remake of Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire for the Game Boy Advance. Featuring original artwork & music, new areas, Secret Base decorations, and more!

Fully compatible with vanilla saves/save editing tools and migration to Pokémon Bank/Home, too!

*No* AI used in the making of this romhack. Just about five years of my time and TLC :)

Thanks to RHH for the pokeemerald-expansion base and pret for the pokeemerald decomp.

Out November 14th!

Website: pokeepsilon.net
Discord: discord.gg/nZ6h4BWdSt

#pokemon #emerald #romhack #oras
